description: This PHP class 'AttendanceDao' provides data access methods for managing attendance records within an HRM system. It includes functionality for saving, retrieving, and checking overlapping punch-in/out records, as well as generating attendance reports and summaries, and handling workflow configurations.

classes.name: AttendanceDao
classes.description: A data access object class that interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations and complex queries related to employee attendance records within the HRM system.

methods.name: savePunchRecord
methods.description: Persists an AttendanceRecord entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getLastPunchRecordByEmployeeNumberAndActionableList
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent AttendanceRecord for a given employee number with a specified list of actionable states.

methods.name: checkForPunchOutOverLappingRecords
methods.description: Checks if the punch-out time overlaps with existing records for the employee, throws exception if it does.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOverLappingRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-in records for the employee before creating a new punch-in.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-in records during editing, considering existing record id and optional punch-out time.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOutOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-in and punch-out times during record editing, with record id consideration.

methods.name: getCommonQueryForPunchOutOverlap
methods.description: Internal method that verifies if a prospective punch-out overlaps with existing punch-in records.

methods.name: getCommonQueryForPunchInOverlap
methods.description: Internal method that verifies if a prospective punch-in overlaps with existing records.

methods.name: getCommonQueryForPunchInOverlap
methods.description: Internal method returning a boolean indicating overlap for punch-in times.

methods.name: hasSavedConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if a specific workflow configuration exists for given parameters.

methods.name: deleteAttendanceRecords
methods.description: Deletes multiple attendance records identified by their IDs.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordById
methods.description: Retrieves an attendance record by ID if the associated employee is not purged.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsByEmpNumberAndIds
methods.description: Retrieves attendance records for a specific employee filtered by a list of record IDs.

methods.name: getLatestAttendanceRecordByEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Gets the latest attendance record for a specific employee.

methods.name: getAttendanceReportCriteriaList
methods.description: Returns a list of attendance report data based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getAttendanceReportPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for attendance report queries based on filters.

methods.name: getAttendanceReportCriteriaListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of attendance report entries matching filters.

methods.name: getTotalAttendanceDuration
methods.description: Calculates the total attendance duration in seconds based on filters.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordList
methods.description: Returns a list of attendance records based on search filters, with pagination.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordListPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for listing attendance records with filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getCommonQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Applies common filtering conditions to a QueryBuilder object based on search parameters.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordListQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Creates a QueryBuilderWrapper for listing attendance records with related employee data.
